reads.stopped_at: Seeing the charge does not decide for you.
reads.what_it_sells: An EUR 80 canvas weekend bag for carrying my things on short trips, with an invitation to resume checkout and see the shipping charge.
reads.relevance_feedback: The profile establishes that I left this weekend bag in my basket, and the email accurately refers to that unfinished checkout. It only conditionally suggests that shipping may affect my decision, so it does not overstate why I stopped; whether shipping was my concern remains unknown.
assumed_experiences: Profile-supported: I placed the CanvasTrail weekend bag in my basket and did not complete checkout.
Email-only: I may want to know the shipping charge before deciding whether to buy.
Email-only: the shipping charge is unavailable in the message and will appear after I resume checkout.
reads.problem_now: There is a pending purchase I previously considered, but the profile establishes no urgency or current need for the bag. Seeing the shipping charge could resolve one unknown, although it is not established that shipping caused me to leave.
reads.biggest_doubt: The email makes me reopen checkout just to discover an unspecified shipping charge, without giving me a stronger reason to spend that effort this morning.
reads.to_click_it_would_have_to: I would have clicked if this email had told me the shipping charge for my basket, or at least the exact checkout step at which I would see it.
fixes: Rewrite "If you want to know the shipping charge before deciding, resume the purchase path." to say exactly how many steps it takes to reveal the charge, or show the charge directly in the email if it is known.

Cut "Seeing the charge does not decide for you. It simply gives you the shipping information that is not available in this message, so you can make the next decision with both the EUR 80 price and checkout charge in view." It repeats the subject and delays the link.

Shorten "Whenever you’re ready to reconsider the bag, return to the basket and take it from there." to a direct description of the next step, such as "Return to your basket to view shipping before payment."
